name: Create Odoo CRM leads from a webhook and auto-follow up after 3 days

parameters.content:
## Create Odoo CRM leads from a webhook and auto-follow up after 3 days

### How it works

This workflow receives new lead submissions via a webhook, validates the required input, creates a CRM lead in Odoo, and sends immediate notifications. It replies to the lead by email, notifies the sales team in Slack, and returns a success response to the webhook caller. In parallel, it waits 3 days, checks whether the Odoo lead is still in the initial stage, and sends a follow-up reminder if no progress has been made.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook endpoint and ensure incoming payloads include the lead fields expected by the validation and Odoo create steps.
- Add and test Odoo credentials, including access to the CRM lead model and the fields used to create and re-fetch leads.
- Connect Gmail credentials for both the immediate auto-reply and the delayed follow-up reminder emails.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the target sales channel for new-lead notifications.
- Ensure n8n wait/resume execution settings are enabled and reliable for the 3-day delay, especially if using queue mode or external storage.
- Review the invalid-input and Odoo-failure webhook responses so they return the correct status codes and error messages for your integration.

### Customization

Adjust the validation rules, Odoo lead field mapping, email templates, Slack channel/message, 3-day wait duration, and the Odoo stage condition that determines whether a follow-up reminder should be sent.

## Receive and validate lead

Handles the incoming webhook, checks whether the lead payload is valid, and returns a 400 response for invalid submissions.

## Create Odoo lead

Creates the CRM lead in Odoo after validation and returns a 502 webhook response if the Odoo create operation fails.

## Send lead auto-reply

Sends an immediate Gmail auto-reply to the new lead and uses a pass-through combine node to continue the successful path.

## Notify sales team

Posts the new lead notification to Slack and then combines the Slack path before branching into the immediate response and delayed follow-up flow.

## Return success response

Sends the webhook success response once the lead has been created and the initial notifications have been processed.

## Delay and reload stage

Waits 3 days, re-fetches the lead stage from Odoo, and includes the nearby background failure sink used when the delayed task or follow-up branch needs to be logged for review.

## Decide follow-up action

Checks whether the lead is still in the new stage, sends a Gmail follow-up reminder when needed, or ends the delayed branch if the lead has already progressed.

nodes.name: Check Lead Name Presence
nodes.notes: Gate: requires a non-empty name AND an email matching a basic email regex. False branch returns 400 without touching Odoo.

nodes.name: Create Odoo CRM Lead
nodes.notes: Creates a crm.lead record (type=lead) in Odoo from the validated webhook payload. Self-heals transient failures (retryOnFail); persistent failures route to the 502 error output.

value.name: ={{ $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.company ? $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.company + ' - ' + $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.name : $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.name }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "upstream_error", "message": "Failed to create the CRM lead in Odoo: " + ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : ($json.message || 'unknown error')) } }}

nodes.name: Send Gmail Auto-Reply
nodes.notes: Auto-reply to the lead. Wired with continueErrorOutput so a bad/undeliverable address never crashes the pipeline — the CRM lead is already created either way.

parameters.message:
={{ '

Hi ' + $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.name + ',

Thanks for contacting us' + ($('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.company ? ' on behalf of ' + $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.company : '') + '. We have logged your request (Lead #' + $json.id + ') and a member of our sales team will get back to you within one business day.

For reference, here is what we received:

' + $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.message + '

Best regards,
The Sales Team

' }}
parameters.subject: ={{ 'Thanks for reaching out, ' + $('When New Lead Posted').item.json.body.name + '!' }}

nodes.name: Continue After Auto-Reply
nodes.notes: Fan-in anchor: both the auto-reply success path and its error path land here so downstream nodes reference this node by name instead of ambiguous $json.

nodes.name: Post to Slack Sales Channel
nodes.notes: Credentials intentionally left unset — pick a Slack credential + channel in the UI. The localhost link is for this demo VPS; swap for the real reachable Odoo host in production. Wired with continueErrorOutput so a not-yet-configured Slack credential can't block lead creation or the success response.

nodes.name: Continue Post-Slack Notification
nodes.notes: Fan-in anchor: both the Slack-post success path and its error path land here before the workflow responds and kicks off the follow-up branch.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "status": "success", "message": "Lead created and sales team notified.", "lead_id": $('Create Odoo CRM Lead').item.json.id } }}

nodes.name: Wait 3 Days for Follow-Up
nodes.notes: Runs after the webhook has already responded (this branch is parallel to the success response). Models a real 'wait a few days and check back' sales cadence.

nodes.name: Fetch Latest Lead Stage
nodes.notes: Re-reads the SAME lead created in Stage 2 by id, 3 days later, to inspect its current stage_id.

nodes.name: Log Background Task Failure
nodes.notes: Demo stand-in for a real alert (email/Slack on a DIFFERENT channel than the one above, per the recursion-trap rule) when the background follow-up check itself fails.

nodes.name: Check If Stage Is New
nodes.notes: True = the lead never left the initial 'New' qualification stage after 3 days → needs a nudge. False = it progressed → no action.

nodes.name: Send Follow-Up Email
nodes.notes: sendTo is a placeholder — wire this to the real assigned-salesperson lookup (e.g. resolve $json.user_id via res.users) before going live.

parameters.message:
={{ '

Hi,

The CRM lead #' + $json.id + ' – ' + $json.name + ' has been sitting in stage ' + ($json.stage_id ? $json.stage_id[1] : 'New') + ' for 3 days with no progress.

Assigned salesperson: ' + ($json.user_id ? $json.user_id[1] : 'Unassigned') + '

Please follow up with the lead or update its stage in Odoo.

' }}
parameters.subject: ={{ 'Reminder: Lead #' + $json.id + ' still needs follow-up' }}

nodes.name: Lead Progressed Notification
nodes.notes: No-op: lead moved past the initial stage on its own, nothing to do.
